prashna_chapter2_verse3.title: Prashna Chapter 2 Verse 3
prashna_chapter2_verse3.introduction: This verse belongs to Prashna, Chapter 2.
prashna_chapter2_verse3.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Prashna Upanishad, Chapter 2, Verse 3, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
prashna_chapter2_verse3.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
